description: This Scala source file defines the DeploymentPodsAllocator class, which manages Kubernetes Deployment resources for Spark executor pods, including scaling, creation, and deletion, with specific handling for annotations and resource profiles.

classes.name: DeploymentPodsAllocator
classes.description: A pods allocator backed by Kubernetes Deployments, responsible for managing executor pods, scaling, and annotations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the allocator with application ID and waits for the driver pod to be ready.

methods.name: setTotalExpectedExecutors
methods.description: Sets the expected number of executors per resource profile and triggers deployment scaling.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether an executor has been deleted (always returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Generates a deployment name based on application ID and resource profile ID.

methods.name: setTargetExecutorsDeployment
methods.description: Creates or scales a Kubernetes Deployment for the specified resource profile and application.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deletes all deployments associated with the application ID.
